reviews.title: No more sick cats
reviews.body: Got this for the cats because they would fight over the wet food and then get sick minutes later. It has helped slow the cats down and completely solved the issue of them becoming sick after eating. The cats like them and adapted to them quickly. The mats are holding up great and are simple to wash and the spatula included was great so we have a dedicated tool. Good price for such a big fix. Big enough for one can of wet food per mat.
